1168-1651-2499-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2499-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2499-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2981-5267-7924.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

240-574-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-7175.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

147-1854-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-3899.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4677-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4677-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2043-4050-6671-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
2034-3192-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2034-3192-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Ulasht to make creature tokens.

275-2034-4215.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
275-2034-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-5776-6351-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2034-6761-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2034-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2999-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3284-3490-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3140-6085-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
3140-6085-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Altanak and causing you to draw a card..
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

413-3234-3293-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2104-4423-6701-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-6701-6886.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-4316-5078--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

222-527-3499-4050.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3054-4050-5687.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-5687.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2498-3591-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1283-3525-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
1283-3525-3918.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

2972-3875-6455-6517.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Dragonback Assault trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve a Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

1445-2438-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

781-6464.description:
Cast Traumatize by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Keening Stone by paying {5} and tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus milling the rest of their library.
781-6464.notes: If the opponent has an odd number of cards in their library and an empty graveyard, the opponent will have one card remaining in their library. Otherwise they will mill their entire library.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

5733-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
5733-6333-6335.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-6333-6335.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng from your graveyard for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

5231-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5231-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

3000-5140-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 4.
3000-5140-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing another creature and paying 1 life, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat step 1 two additional times using the Squirrel token instead.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {2}{W}, causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat.
3000-5140-5670.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2557-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
2557-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1445-4885-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4885-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1879-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-2060-3525-5027.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Gnostro.
You have a storm count of at least one.
104-2060-3525-5027.description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.

1187-2292-2466-2527-2972.notablePrerequisites: Ganax does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1187-2292-2466-2527-2972.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Ganax.
Ganax triggers, causing all Dragons you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ganax.
When Ganax dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ganax, dealing two damage to any target.
Repeat.

549-803-1558-4338.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
549-803-1558-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3031-4398.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell and allowing the player to copy each spell exiled by Eye of the Storm and cast them from exile.
Because Drannith Magistrate prevents opponent from playing spells from anywhere but their hands, they cannot cast the copies made by Eye of the Storm.

804-2724-3194.description:
Cast Sakashima for {2}{U}{U}, entering as a copy of Wormfang Manta.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.

224-872-1362.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4031-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control a Cleric creature, a Rogue creature, and a Warrior creature.
4031-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ardent Electromancer.
Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat

65-615-717-875-2628.description:
Activate Fetid Pools's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Fetid Pools, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Fetid Pools trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Cartographer.
Cartographer enters the battlefield, returning Fetid Pools from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
